text: Apply only snapshots newer than the ticket's stored version; duplicates/older versions have no effect.
criteria: Deliver 1,3,2,3 for T-01; final version is 3 and no counter increments from duplicates/older input.

text: Keep list membership and queue/status counts consistent with the latest applied ticket state through a reviewed transaction design.
criteria: Crash during a queue move; after recovery, ticket placement and both queues' counts equal the reference result.

text: Expose paged queue/status lists and counts only to authorized supervisors, without mixing view generations.
criteria: A Q-A-only supervisor cannot read Q-B; a cursor from generation 1 cannot silently continue across generation 2.

text: Show last processed checkpoint and data freshness; do not label a stale view as current.
criteria: Pause consumption, advance source checkpoint and inspect a visible lag/stale state.

text: Rebuild a new generation from an authoritative snapshot plus subsequent events, verify convergence, then switch the active generation explicitly.
criteria: Rebuild from K while later snapshots arrive; compare every ticket/count before controlled activation and preserve rollback generation.

text: For 1000 tickets and a 100-event burst, converge within 30 seconds under nominal conditions and meet the shared query target after convergence.
criteria: Execute the 1000-ticket/100-event workload and independently compare converged records/counts and timings.
